title: Parliament Session Disrupted Again Amid Opposition Protests
summary: The Parliament session was disrupted again on Saturday as opposition parties staged protests, with the Rajya Sabha being suspended for two hours. The Lok Sabha's proceedings continued despite the disruptions. The government is preparing to push four major bills during the monsoon session, but it faces a tough challenge in convincing the opposition.
summary_points: The Parliament session was disrupted again on Saturday as opposition parties staged protests.
The Rajya Sabha was suspended for two hours due to the protests.
The Lok Sabha's proceedings continued despite the disruptions.
The government is preparing to push four major bills during the monsoon session.
The opposition faces a tough challenge in convincing the government on its demands.

framing.left: Left-leaning outlets foregrounded the crackdown on protesters, highlighting detentions and alleging suppression of dissent. They stressed the foreign-donation angle and the demand for an audit.
framing.center: Centrist coverage largely reported the events without a distinct frame. However, some outlets highlighted the government's push to pass four major bills during the monsoon session.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets framed the funding row as a national-security concern, stressing the foreign-donation angle and the demand for an audit. They also emphasized the government's efforts to push through its legislative agenda.
